seo.title: Pharma Expert Engagement Platform - emQube

softwarePortfolioLayout.aboutApplication:
The platform provides a responsive Angular JS front-end interface where agency administrators input detailed meeting schedules, speaker availability, and event compliance parameters. Internal coordinators and medical experts interact directly with the portal to log attendance sheets, submit necessary documentation, and record specific interaction details for 1-to-1 professional engagements.


The robust Microsoft .NET Core framework processes these inputs by automatically calculating complex honorarium fees and travel expenses based on predefined rules stored within a secure SQL Server database. Hosted entirely on Azure, the system outputs verified disbursement reports, automated financial metrics, and structured audit logs, ensuring the agency maintains strict regulatory oversight without relying on manual spreadsheets.
softwarePortfolioLayout.clientName: A California-based firm providing specialized communication and collaboration services to the global pharmaceutical industry.
softwarePortfolioLayout.testimonialContent: Managing expert engagements used to involve a lot of complex, manual expense tracking. emQube’s platform automated our honorarium calculations and gave us reliable reporting, which has brought a much higher level of scalability and efficiency to our outreach programs.
